enterprise.name: Cropping Cotton Enterprise
enterprise.description: A cotton cropping enterprise: emissions from cotton crop production (fertiliser, crop residue), plus the farm's energy, waste and upstream (Scope 3) emissions. Cotton shares the Chapter 2 'Cropping' module map with grains/legumes/sugarcane/forage.

modules.comment: Cotton cropping has its own fertiliser production systems inputs.

Cotton cropping only needs the crop residue chain (cotton stalks / gin trash): 6.1 Crop residue N2O, 6.3 Leach runoff crop and 6.4 Residue burning (which depend only on the crop residue sheet and Input - Crop, not on any pasture sheet or Input - Pasture). 6.2 Pasture residue N2O is not required. Input - Crop is supplied by the enterprise template (declared in customSheets), so it is listed here only to KEEP the input subset explicit - omitting the 'input' key makes the builder fall back to this module's full registry input list, which pulls in Input - Pasture. Input - Crop being a customSheet means it is skipped here, not imported.

Scope 3 upstream sources for a cropping enterprise: purchased fertiliser (15.4), agrichemicals (15.5), lime (15.6), services/contractors (15.7), other goods & services (15.10), upstream fuel (15.11), upstream electricity (15.12) and waste management (15.13) - all handled by the '15 Scope 3' sheet. The Scope 3 module's livestock-purchase input sheets are not relevant to a crop-only enterprise.

menu.comment: The column-A navigation menu is regenerated on every sheet from the final sheet set. Groups are assigned automatically: Home/Results = untitled; any sheet named 'Input*' = INPUTS; calculation sheets = CALCULATIONS; everything else = APPENDICES. 'labels' overrides the link text for a sheet (default derivation strips the 'Input - ' prefix, otherwise uses the sheet name). Set enabled=false to leave existing menus untouched.
